title: Neutrino masses, mixing and a nonzero double-beta amplitude from Fold geometry
description:
Read the full mathematical paper (PDF)

Three positive neutrino masses, exact mixing entries and a strictly nonzero double-beta amplitude derived from Smithian Fold Theory.

Maria Smith derives the exact mass-square ladder (1/32, 33/32, 3203/96), solar-to-atmospheric splitting ratio 3/100 and mixing entries (1/2, 1/3, 1/48). The unique self-antipodal half-One fixes the phase carrier and one-hand Majorana coupling. Exact weighted root bounds prove noncancellation for every admitted phase opposition.

Using the original registered solar mass-squared anchor, the masses are approximately 1.529910, 8.788665 and 49.990072 meV, with sum 60.308647 meV and refined double-beta amplitude bounds 0.828371–4.908674 meV. The paper includes the complete mathematical derivations, exhaustive candidate classifications, rational enclosure algorithm, original PDG mixing and mass comparisons, Planck base-ΛCDM-plus-BAO comparison and the original double-beta non-observation record.

Seven formal entries and two empirical entries retain native Lean 4 proofs, complete source-output comparisons and 918 distinct audited declarations with zero axiom dependencies. The source archive includes original pinned V3 laws, native V4 proof modules and imports, registered source records and verification receipts.
